name: Celicia
source:
Commander of the 3rd Squadron of the Royal Guard of Graldan. She is the only daughter of a knight's family of prestige but declining power.

She is a strong, simple, and virtuous person with a solid skill with the sword. She is highly trusted by her subordinates.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/selicia/index.html]official site[/url]]
